title: Contract Pricing Agreement Substitute Claims: Paid-Invoice Credit
content:
# Paid-invoice credit on substitute claims — Contract Pricing Agreement

**Rule.** The paid-invoice credit follows the payment of the claimed invoice on the customer's Commercial Credit Account. An invoice is covered when its payments, earned discount and applied credit memos cover its amount.

| Invoice | Paid-invoice credit |
|---|---|
| Covered, with its latest payment 30 or more days before the handling date | 1.5 percent |
| Covered, with its latest payment fewer days before | 0.75 percent |
| Not yet covered, or covered without any customer payment on it | No credit |

The credit adds that percent of the unrounded claim amount — the overbilling per unit multiplied by the claim quantity — before the claim amount's rounding to the cent. Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one. Wherever a latest or most recent record of a kind is taken, it is the one with the latest date, and among records of the same date the one recorded first.

Hypothetical example: an invoice of 2140.00 covered by a payment of 2120.00 and a discount of 20.00, the payment dated 45 days before the handling date, adds 1.5 percent; on an unrounded claim amount of 100.00 that is 1.50.
